meta.title: Lusion - Oryzo AI
meta.description: Our detailed case study on Oryzo AI. Produced by Lusion.
meta.ogDescription: Our detailed case study on Oryzo AI. Produced by Lusion.

paragraphs.text: Oryzo AI is a self initiated project by Lusion built around a deliberately ridiculous idea: presenting a simple cork coaster as a serious AI era product launch. We treated it as a full campaign, combining premium visual production with satire to see how far craft, storytelling, and presentation could push an ordinary object.
paragraphs.html: Oryzo AI is a self initiated project by Lusion built around a deliberately ridiculous idea: presenting a simple cork coaster as a serious AI era product launch. We treated it as a full campaign, combining premium visual production with satire to see how far craft, storytelling, and presentation could push an ordinary object.

paragraphs.text: Beyond the main website, we extended the idea across a GitHub page, Product Hunt launch, founder video, and social content. It gave us room to experiment more freely with tone and campaign thinking, while showing the same level of design, motion, and digital production we bring to client work.

meta.title: Lusion - Atlas Motion
meta.description: Our detailed case study on Atlas Motion. Produced by Lusion.
meta.ogDescription: Our detailed case study on Atlas Motion. Produced by Lusion.

paragraphs.text: Atlas is building next generation motion systems for drones, robotics, and autonomous hardware. We worked with the team to create a focused digital experience that turns a complex manufacturing story into something clear, confident, and tangible. The site introduces Atlas’ joint development model, brings their product and factory story to the surface, and uses precise motion, visual pacing, and selective WebGL to communicate the scale of their ambition without losing the seriousness of the category.

meta.title: Lusion - Of The Oak
meta.description: Our detailed case study on Of The Oak. Produced by Lusion.
meta.ogDescription: Our detailed case study on Of The Oak. Produced by Lusion.

paragraphs.text: MLF approached us to create a web companion for Of The Oak, their physical installation created in collaboration with Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. Designed to extend the project beyond the installation itself, the experience gave onsite visitors a more interactive way to engage with the work while also making it accessible to online audiences.

paragraphs.text: The website helped bridge the physical and digital experience, offering a space for visitors to explore the project in greater depth and learn more about its story, ideas, and context.

meta.title: Lusion - Meta: Spatial Fusion
meta.description: Our detailed case study on Meta: Spatial Fusion. Produced by Lusion.
meta.ogDescription: Our detailed case study on Meta: Spatial Fusion. Produced by Lusion.

paragraphs.text: Lusion partnered with Phoria and Meta to create Spatial Fusion, an immersive WebXR experience that pushed the possibilities of web based mixed reality. Built with technologies such as spatial anchors, plane detection, and full color passthrough, the project explored new ways for users to interact with digital content in physical space.

Built with technologies such as spatial anchors, plane detection, and full color passthrough, the project explored new ways for users to interact with digital content in physical space.

paragraphs.text: Bringing together expertise across creative technology, immersive design, and web development, the collaboration helped turn a complex technical challenge into a seamless spatial storytelling experience. The result was a forward looking mixed reality venture that invited users into a new kind of interactive world.

meta.title: Lusion - Worldcoin Globe
meta.description: Our detailed case study on Worldcoin Globe. Produced by Lusion.
meta.ogDescription: Our detailed case study on Worldcoin Globe. Produced by Lusion.

paragraphs.text: In collaboration with Tools for Humanity, we successfully integrated the dynamic Worldcoin 3D globe visualizer onto their website.
paragraphs.html: In collaboration with Tools for Humanity, we successfully integrated the dynamic Worldcoin 3D globe visualizer onto their website.

paragraphs.text: Our team crafted specialized APIs, empowering the Worldcoin developer team to seamlessly activate visual effects in response to real-time user registration data. Furthermore, we innovatively embedded and compressed country and visual information into an image data format, optimizing GPU-based rendering for efficiency and speed.

Furthermore, we innovatively embedded and compressed country and visual information into an image data format, optimizing GPU-based rendering for efficiency and speed.

media.text: All dot positions are procedrually generated and animated in real-time. We used the index breakpoints to reduce the data needed to store the country data and the dot positions. This allowed us to store the data in a single image file, which is then decoded and rendered on the fly.

meta.title: Lusion - The Turn Of The Screw
meta.description: Our detailed case study on The Turn Of The Screw. Produced by Lusion.
meta.ogTitle: Lusion - The Turn Of The Screw
meta.ogDescription: Our detailed case study on The Turn Of The Screw. Produced by Lusion.

paragraphs.text: In October 2019, Opera North, alongside the Audiolab of York University and the sound artist James Bulley, came to Lusion for a collaboration on an innovative cultural project. Their idea was to record the Turn of the Screw opera in a spatialized way, then place these recordings in an explorable 3D environment. The main goal of this project was to create an audiovisual walk through a binaural landscape.
